resources.string: AI tools share one action allowance. Translation counts processed characters. Voice-note transcription and live captions share recorded usage; voicemail is separate. A zero limit means no included allowance. Feature eligibility still depends on your plan.
App calls count each connected person\'s time against the caller\'s allowance. Two people calling for one minute use two participant-minutes.
Reaching a limit pauses that feature until reset. It does not stop ordinary in-app text chat. Usage updates after processing; refresh for the latest balance.
